Thus the eigenvalues lie in [1-tK,1+tK], supplying precisely the relative-row and cancellation premises in Tang 4.1 and 5.1. The premise is available from an explicitly cited local proof, even though the ModFKV Statement does not repeat the eigenvalue conclusion. No edit is warranted.
